headline: Join the team building DAWN.
sub: We recruit across all six departments. If you are a FISAT student who wants to build hardware and software that competes on the world stage — this is the shortest path from classroom to Mars-analogue.

process.title: Apply
process.body: Submit an application indicating your top two departments of interest.

process.title: Interview
process.body: Meet the department leads for a scoped technical conversation.

process.title: Onboard
process.body: Complete a small onboarding project shipped to the current build.

process.title: Join
process.body: Get badged into the workspace, tooling, and season roadmap.

wanted: Design & Manufacturing — CAD, CNC, structural analysis
Electrical — power electronics, PCB design, motor drivers
Controls & Embedded — real-time firmware, tele-op, kinematics
AI & Autonomy — SLAM, computer vision, path planning
Science — payload design, geology, life-detection protocols
Research & Documentation — technical writing, media, sponsor collateral
